verify_detail: twork jitter — it's a fully deterministic, persistent state machine that two out of every five cold starts happens to render without the button.\n\n**Fix direction for the team:** the test either needs to reset app data (clear the `launchCount` pref / uninstall-reinstall) before each run so it always starts at a known-good phase, or the app's `SyncComponent` needs to stop driving a real UI affordance off of what looks like a canned/demo rotation counter rather than an actual sync-service state."
